title: Opening Day at the Light
story: Thimble Point Light opened for the season on a blustery April Saturday, and Lena Kowalski, white gloves and all, made an announcement from the top step. The 1876 Keeper's Lamp, a ceremonial light since the lighthouse retired from guiding ships, turns 150 this year: it will shine every evening of Lantern Festival week and get a birthday lighting on Festival night. Four volunteers each took one opening-day job. Who did which job?

Jonah took charge of either the gift shop or the tours.
Faye took charge of neither the tours nor the cocoa stand.
